title: Song - Praise to the Lord (simplified)
composer: Traditional (German, tune "Lobe den Herren", Stralsund Gesangbuch 1665)
subtitle: Arrangement: the tune with left-hand block chords
trains: Praise to the Lord in F major and 3/4, over one held block chord a bar in the left (F, C, B♭).

provenance.author: claude-opus-5.5
provenance.basedOn: mutopia-1256-lobe-den-herren: Lobe den Herren (hymntune), SATB, sounding F major; the tune is in the Soprano (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1256)
provenance.note: Melody from www.cyberhymnal.org (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1256), public domain; left-hand chords our own (CC0)

departures: Left-hand block chords are our own (CC0).
Simplified: one block chord a bar, held, with the three primary chords only (F, C, B♭), instead of the full version's moving left hand.
Slower: 88 instead of 104 quarter notes a minute.
